tasks.title: Refresh tool identity and display titles on transcript updates
tasks.description: Make backend transcript normalization recompute tool identity, displayTitle, targets, and prompt summary metadata whenever later tool lifecycle updates arrive. This task should fix stale generic labels such as `skill`, `bash`, or `unknown`, infer `skill` and `task` from late semantic data, and collapse duplicate prompt output-target metadata into one canonical line.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed skill load renders the loaded skill name instead of only `skill` or `unknown` when title or input contains that information
`skill` and `task` events are not normalized as unknown tools when title, rawInput, or metadata is sufficient to identify them
When a `tool_call_update` provides a more specific title, target, raw input, output, or metadata, the normalized transcript record uses the updated semantic values
Prompt summary data does not preserve duplicate output-path lines when subtitle and outputPath describe the same target
Backend transcript tests cover stale-title replacement, `skill`/`task` inference, and prompt output-path deduplication
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the existing transcript shape backward-compatible while making normalizedName, displayTitle, and prompt summary fields late-update aware.

tasks.title: Add normalized semantic details for common tool families
tasks.description: Extend transcript normalization so common tool families produce one structured semantic-details contract that survives persistence and replay. Cover context, execution, planning, delegation, interaction/network, skill, and mutation families, including bounded previews and one normalized change-view model for `apply_patch`, `edit`, and `write`.
acceptanceCriteria: Context tools preserve user-facing details such as path, pattern, query, include, offset, limit, and concise result summaries when available
`bash` and `shell` preserve command, cwd, status, exit code, and bounded output preview when available
`todowrite` or `todo` preserve todo items, completion counts, and status summaries when todos are present
`task` preserves subagent type or name, task description, and child session identifiers when available
`question`, `webfetch`, and `websearch` preserve question, URL, or query semantics plus concise output previews when available
`apply_patch`, `edit`, and `write` normalize reviewable per-file change data with file path, operation type, additions or deletions when available, and diff or content payloads when derivable
Replay of persisted transcript data exposes the same semantic detail fields as live normalization for the same tool inputs
Backend transcript tests cover semantic detail extraction for at least one representative tool in each required family
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consume the late-update normalization from T-001 so semantic details are derived from final tool state instead of placeholder lifecycle events.

tasks.title: Project semantic transcript data into readable tool rows
tasks.description: Update the frontend transcript projection and tool registry so semantic titles and structured details become the default reading experience instead of raw JSON or generic tool-family labels. This task should preserve existing context grouping while keeping expanded child rows concrete, stop suppressing useful todo tools, and add missing first-class renderers for the supported families.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool rows prefer backend-provided semantic display titles over generic lifecycle names when rendering completed tools
Expanded context groups show concrete per-tool targets for `read`, `list`, `glob`, `grep`, `search`, and `search_files` rows instead of only generic tool names
`todowrite` or `todo` rows are rendered when they contain user-meaningful progress and show compact status summaries
`task`, `question`, `webfetch`, `websearch`, `skill`, and `bash` rows render family-specific titles and summaries instead of unknown or raw JSON-first views
Missing registry entries for supported families are added without breaking the existing grouped transcript layout
Frontend tests cover semantic row titles, grouped child row targets, todo visibility, and renderer selection for representative tool families
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use normalized semantic details first and keep raw JSON only as a fallback path when a renderer cannot derive a readable summary.

tasks.title: Render mutation tools as reviewable file changes
tasks.description: Implement the mutation-tool expansion experience around the normalized change-view model so users can review what changed without reading raw payload JSON. `apply_patch`, `edit`, and `write` should show affected files, operations, additions or deletions when available, and expandable diff or content views derived from patch text, before or after values, or metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: `apply_patch` rows show affected files, operation type, additions or deletions when available, and an expandable diff body parsed from patchText or equivalent metadata
`edit` rows show the target file and an expandable before or after diff when old or new strings or diff metadata are available
`write` rows show the target file and written content, and prefer a diff view when before or after or diff metadata exists
Raw JSON input or output is not the primary expansion view for mutation tools when a semantic change representation can be derived
Frontend tests cover representative `apply_patch`, `edit`, and `write` expansions with normalized change data
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Build on the shared change-view contract from T-002 and the renderer wiring from T-003 so all mutation families use one reviewable presentation model.

tasks.title: Prove live and replay transcript parity for semantic tool rendering
tasks.description: Add regression coverage and any final API or hook wiring needed so live streaming and persisted replay render the same semantic tool rows for the same session data. Verification should cover the concrete #228 and #229 failure modes around late titles, grouped context tools, mutation tools, todo visibility, and execution summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: A live session that receives late `tool_call_update` data renders the same final titles and semantic details after page refresh and persisted replay
Regression coverage proves grouped context tools retain concrete child titles after replay, not only during live streaming
Regression coverage proves `bash`, `skill`, `task`, `todowrite`, `apply_patch`, `edit`, and `write` retain their semantic rendering in both live and replay paths
Regression coverage proves prompt output target is displayed once in the transcript page
Relevant backend and frontend test suites pass for representative issue #228 or #229 transcript fixtures
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Proved live/replay parity: backend replay parity tests (lines 2780-2834 in session-transcript-service.test.ts), frontend Live/historical parity tests (SessionPage.test.tsx), and context grouping tests prove all acceptance criteria. Typecheck passes. All 159 backend transcript tests pass.
